title: All-q Levi apartment incidence kernel and cycle-space tight frame
purpose: Extend Pass5388-5395 from the abstract Hodge idempotent to the explicit matrix of all oriented Levi 8-cycle apartments. Count apartment completions through pairs of flag edges, prove the signed overlap law (-1)^d q^(4-d), derive C C^T=N E_-2, count all apartments, and recover the q=3 160x1620 cycle-frame theorem as an exact specialization.
outcomes: Proved every nonbacktracking five-edge Levi path has a unique apartment completion and derived q^(4-d) apartments through a distance-d flag-edge pair.
Counted q^4 apartments through every flag edge and N q^4/8 total apartments, with N=(q+1)^2(q^2+1).
Derived unsigned pair overlap q^4,q^3,q^2,q,1 and signed overlap q^4,-q^3,q^2,-q,1 by line-graph distance.
Proved C C^T=q^4A0-q^3A1+q^2A2-qA3+A4=N E_-2, so rank(C)=q^4 and the full apartment family is a tight frame for the Levi cycle space.
After dividing apartment columns by sqrt(8), obtained a unit-norm tight frame of N q^4/8 vectors in dimension q^4 with frame bound N/8.
Recovered the q=3 W33 certificate exactly: C is 160x1620, rank 81, signed kernel 81,-27,9,-3,1, and C C^T=160 E_-2.
Added executable verifier, frozen certificate, cross-regression against BT546, manuscript insert, public card source, publication-contract registration, and replay/compile workflow.
boundary: The theorem concerns the complete apartment family and does not claim that arbitrary selected apartment subsets are tight. Targeted literature search found related generalized-quadrangle ETF constructions, so no broad priority claim is made for GQ-derived tight frames. The packet asserts the explicit full-apartment cycle-incidence/Hodge identity. No code-distance or physical fault-tolerance conclusion follows by itself. GitHub Actions was still queued at closure time, so remote CI success is not claimed.
